description: Land Acquisition - Udawela, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific lands are needed for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land matters (acquisition for public purpose) without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or electoral matters.
